payload.summary: The same report a year earlier, for 2025/26. It identifies £3.2m of permanent savings and extra income, records that the prudent minimum general reserve "was set at £5.4 million by full Council in February 2024" and "has been increased to £5.5 million", and volunteers that the previous year was heading for a £0.65m overspend "primarily as a consequence of inaccurate expectations around income streams relating to car parking", which it re-based by £425,000.
